top_signals.title: 1 in 4 people in Japan believes AI could replace friends and family: poll
top_signals.summary: In the survey, 30.8% of the overall respondents said they use generative AI, such as ChatGPT, while 67.8% said they do not.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
